response.rationale: The item is apparel (not electronics), not final sale, not defective, no goodwill grant, and no fraud hold. Delivery was 50 days ago, exceeding the 30-day standard window. RET-008 applies (days_since_delivery > 30 and not final sale), making the return ineligible. No higher-priority rule (defective RET-020 or final-sale RET-012) applies.
